newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai boy, 4, accidentally shoots and kills brother.
newsitem.headline: Thai boy, 4, accidentally shoots and kills brother.

text.p: A four-year-old Thai boy accidentally shot and killed his five-year old brother while playing with their father's shotgun, police said on Sunday.
Police in Thakham, on the outskirts of Bangkok, said the accident took place late on Saturday.
The parents told police they were in their home when the two boys went to play in the parents' bedroom upstairs and found a shotgun belonging to their father.
The father was detained by police for possession of a firearm without a permit, police said.
